description: Daily database backup: a pg_dump->S3 CronJob with an IRSA ServiceAccount, wired into base with a mandatory per-overlay BACKUP_PREFIX patch and a 443/TCP egress addition to the NetworkPolicy; plus the scripts/bootstrap_backups.py provisioning script (S3 bucket + backup-ONLY KMS CMK) with a unit test and boto3 dev deps. Depends on FEAT-001 (the k8s-check gate and overlay structure must already be in place so the new manifests render and validate). The CronJob consumes the ESO-managed app-secrets Secret, so it also depends on FEAT-001's ExternalSecret.
steps: Create deploy/k8s/base/backup-serviceaccount.yaml: ServiceAccount named backup, annotation eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: PLACEHOLDER_BACKUP_ROLE_ARN, automountServiceAccountToken: true (IRSA needs the projected web-identity token — differs from the `app` SA which is false).

Create deploy/k8s/base/backup-cronjob.yaml: batch/v1 CronJob db-backup; schedule '0 3 * * *' (daily UTC); concurrencyPolicy Forbid; successful/failedJobsHistoryLimit set. Pod template metadata.labels MUST include app.kubernetes.io/name: k8s-fastapi-starter (load-bearing for NetworkPolicy selection) AND app.kubernetes.io/component: backup. serviceAccountName: backup. Pod securityContext runAsNonRoot:true, runAsUser/Group/fsGroup 10001, seccompProfile RuntimeDefault. Container securityContext allowPrivilegeEscalation:false, readOnlyRootFilesystem:true, runAsNonRoot:true, capabilities.drop:[ALL], seccompProfile RuntimeDefault. restartPolicy OnFailure, backoffLimit, activeDeadlineSeconds, ttlSecondsAfterFinished, resources requests/limits. Writable /tmp emptyDir (sizeLimit). image PLACEHOLDER_BACKUP_IMAGE. Container env BACKUP_PREFIX: base (neutral base placeholder) and DD_TRACE_ENABLED: 'false'. envFrom: - secretRef: {name: app-secrets}. Command streams `pg_dump "$DATABASE_URL" | gzip` to `aws s3 cp - s3://PLACEHOLDER_BACKUP_BUCKET/${BACKUP_PREFIX}/db/<timestamp>.sql.gz --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id PLACEHOLDER_BACKUP_KMS_KEY_ID`.

Add backup-serviceaccount.yaml and backup-cronjob.yaml to deploy/k8s/base/kustomization.yaml resources:; rewrite that file's header secrets-caveat comment (app-secrets is materialized by ESO from the overlay ExternalSecret; base lists no secret/ExternalSecret itself).

In deploy/k8s/base/networkpolicy.yaml add `- protocol: TCP; port: 443` to the EXISTING any-IP (no-`to:`) egress rule (the one with 5432/6379/8126/8125) with a reason comment (backup pod needs 443 for S3, STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity, KMS, Secrets Manager). Add a one-line note in the existing TIGHTEN comment that any future `to:` selector must preserve the backup pod's egress to Postgres 5432 and 443. Do NOT touch the kube-system DNS rule.

In deploy/k8s/overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml and prod/kustomization.yaml add a MANDATORY patch setting the db-backup container env BACKUP_PREFIX to `dev` / `prod` respectively (prevents dev/prod S3 collisions).

Run uv run poe k8s-check: run kube-linter (pinned 0.8.3 behavior, empty exclude: []) against dev/prod WITH the CronJob present and confirm ZERO new diagnostics. If a default check fires (likeliest default-service-account / token-automount on automountServiceAccountToken: true), add the exclusion to deploy/k8s/.kube-linter.yaml WITH a written reason per SPEC §14.9 in THIS feature and re-run. Confirm both overlay renders show BACKUP_PREFIX patched to the env name and the backup pod carries app.kubernetes.io/name: k8s-fastapi-starter.
Run `uv add --dev boto3 "boto3-stubs[s3,kms]"` (updates pyproject.toml + uv.lock; never hand-edit the lock).

Create scripts/bootstrap_backups.py matching scripts/check_sops_encrypted.py conventions (module docstring, typed mypy --strict-clean functions, argparse, main(argv: list[str]) -> int, stdlib + boto3): args --bucket (default literal PLACEHOLDER_BACKUP_BUCKET), --kms-alias/--kms-key (placeholder defaults), --region, --retention-days (default 30), --dry-run (DEFAULT) vs --apply. Behavior: idempotent create-if-absent for bucket + CMK + alias; enable versioning, block public access, default SSE-KMS with the new CMK, lifecycle rule expiring objects after --retention-days; --apply with a still-PLACEHOLDER_ bucket/key/region is a HARD error; S3 bucket name validation (lowercase, 3-63 chars, DNS-ish) + non-empty region; deterministic --dry-run plan output that names the 30-day expiry. Not wired into check/check-all. Optionally add a [tool.poe.tasks.backup-bootstrap] convenience task (dry-run default).

Create tests/unit/test_bootstrap_backups.py (unit, no AWS; mock boto3 or use moto): cover arg parsing, bucket-name + region validation, the --apply-with-placeholder hard-error guard, and the --dry-run plan asserting the 30-day expiry. Follow the pytest style in tests/unit/test_config.py.
Run uv run poe check and confirm lint + mypy --strict + pytest (incl. the new test) pass.
acceptance_criteria: uv run poe k8s-check exits 0 with the backup CronJob + SA present; kube-linter reports zero new diagnostics (or an added exclusion in .kube-linter.yaml carries a written reason).
Both overlay renders show db-backup with BACKUP_PREFIX patched to dev/prod and the pod labeled app.kubernetes.io/name: k8s-fastapi-starter.
networkpolicy.yaml any-IP egress rule includes 443/TCP; the DNS rule is unchanged.
uv run poe check exits 0; mypy --strict passes scripts/bootstrap_backups.py with no blanket type: ignore; tests/unit/test_bootstrap_backups.py passes.
bootstrap_backups.py --dry-run (default) against the placeholder bucket prints a deterministic plan naming a 30-day expiry; --apply with a placeholder bucket/key/region exits non-zero.
boto3 and boto3-stubs[s3,kms] are added as dev deps via uv (pyproject.toml + uv.lock updated, lock not hand-edited).
verification: uv run python scripts/bootstrap_backups.py --dry-run (prints plan, exits 0) and `uv run python scripts/bootstrap_backups.py --apply` (exits non-zero on placeholder guard)
findings: DONE. kube-linter EXCLUSIONS ADDED (deploy/k8s/.kube-linter.yaml, each with a written reason per SPEC §14.9): (1) 'latest-tag' — the backup container image is the bare untagged FILL token PLACEHOLDER_BACKUP_IMAGE (must stay bare so the template builds and `rg PLACEHOLDER_` finds it; the consumer replaces it with a digest-pinned image at init), which kube-linter's latest-tag BlockList flags as 'latest'; (2) 'job-ttl-seconds-after-finished' — the CronJob jobTemplate sets ttlSecondsAfterFinished alongside successful/failedJobsHistoryLimit; kube-linter warns they can interact, but both only DELETE finished Jobs so it is harmless and deliberate. The default-service-account/token-automount check did NOT fire on the backup SA's automountServiceAccountToken: true (0.8.3 does not flag that), so no exclusion was needed there. IMPORTANT WIRING FIX: the poe k8s-check task invoked `kube-linter lint` WITHOUT --config, so deploy/k8s/.kube-linter.yaml was never actually read (FEAT-001 passed with empty exclude only because the config was ignored). Added `--config deploy/k8s/.kube-linter.yaml` to the kube-linter invocation in [tool.poe.tasks.k8s-check] so the committed exclusions take effect (local==CI). MYPY: added 'scripts' to [tool.mypy].files so mypy --strict covers scripts/bootstrap_backups.py (it was previously uncovered; check_sops_encrypted.py is already strict-clean). One cast needed: boto3-stubs type LocationConstraint as a closed Literal of region names, so create_bucket's CreateBucketConfiguration uses cast('BucketLocationConstraintType', region) under TYPE_CHECKING (no blanket type: ignore). The script's internal prefix constant is TOKEN_PREFIX = 'PLACEHOLDER'+'_' (built from parts) so the identifier itself is NOT a false `rg PLACEHOLDER_` hit; only the four real DEFAULT_* fill tokens (PLACEHOLDER_BACKUP_BUCKET, PLACEHOLDER_BACKUP_KMS_ALIAS, PLACEHOLDER_BACKUP_KMS_KEY_ID, PLACEHOLDER_AWS_REGION) match. New placeholder tokens registered in .template/placeholders.yml fill: PLACEHOLDER_BACKUP_BUCKET, PLACEHOLDER_BACKUP_IMAGE (documented: pin by digest), PLACEHOLDER_BACKUP_KMS_KEY_ID, PLACEHOLDER_BACKUP_KMS_ALIAS, PLACEHOLDER_BACKUP_ROLE_ARN; PLACEHOLDER_AWS_REGION files list extended to include scripts/bootstrap_backups.py. NetworkPolicy: added 443/TCP to the EXISTING any-IP egress rule (alongside 5432/6379/8126/8125) with a reason and a TIGHTEN note that any future to: selector must preserve backup egress to 5432+443; the kube-system DNS rule untouched. Overlay renders confirmed: BACKUP_PREFIX patched to dev/prod via a JSON6902 patch on env[0].value; backup pod carries app.kubernetes.io/name: k8s-fastapi-starter + component: backup. VERIFICATION: `uv run poe k8s-check` passes (pass a 22/22 valid; pass b 5 CRDs resolved, 17 core skipped; kube-linter 'No lint errors found!'). lint + ruff format + mypy --strict clean; all 39 unit tests pass incl. 11 new tests/unit/test_bootstrap_backups.py (arg parsing, bucket-name+region validation, --apply placeholder hard-error, --dry-run 30-day-expiry plan + custom retention). bootstrap_backups.py --dry-run exits 0 and prints the 30-day plan; --apply against placeholders exits 1. NOTE: 3 tests/integration/test_items_api.py tests error under `poe check` (full pytest) because they need DATABASE_URL/REDIS_URL + a migrated DB; this is environmental and pre-existing (the local docker-compose postgres-data volume was initialized with mismatched creds), entirely unrelated to FEAT-002 which adds no app runtime code and no integration tests. All tests/unit pass. NOTE for FEAT-004 (docs): docs/deployment.md should document the backup CronJob, bootstrap_backups.py (--dry-run default, --apply guard, --retention-days), the dedicated pg_dump+awscli image pinned by digest, and that the k8s-check kube-linter now runs with --config (the two backup-related exclusions live in deploy/k8s/.kube-linter.yaml).
